messages:
Nate: quick afternoon check

I mocked an alternative where the timeline is a vertical list with large commit bars and a sticky header that shows selected snapshot details. Link: https://img.redwood.test/mocks/vertical-tl.png
Priya: I like the sticky details, but we should make the commit message truncation accessible with a 'show full' button. Also the sticky header needs to skip when a screen reader is navigating the list (use aria-hidden toggles).
a11y-bot: scan: 2 issues


images lack alt text, and sticky header uses role=banner which confuses NVDA. Suggest role=region and aria-label="Snapshot details".
Nate: noted. will swap role and add 'show full' action for commit messages.
